app_description: Baadh, raadi, oo wax ka beddel cuntooyinka lagu kaydiyay markdown ahaan kaydka git.
settings_spellcheck_hint: Hubinta higgaadda biraawsarka ee tafatirayaasha foomka, qoraalka hodanka ah, iyo markdown
settings_fractions_hint: Ku beddela jajabyada la qoray astaamo
settings_random_hint: Muuji badhanka cuntada random-ka ah agtiisa raadinta
settings_cache_clear: Nadiifi kaydka ku meel gaarka ah
settings_cache_hint: Nadiifisa nuxurka cuntooyinka la keydiyay (ammaan; waxay kharash gelisaa dalabyo yar oo dheeraad ah)
settings_cache_confirm_hint: Mar kale taabo si aad u nadiifiso kaydka
about_intro: Cuntooyin ka yimid kayd GitHub, GitLab, ama Gitea ah, oo lagu muujiyay biraawsarkaaga. Ma jiro akoon, server, ama kaydka xogta.
about_markdown: Cuntooyinku waa markdown caadi ah oo leh YAML frontmatter, sidaas darteed kaydkaagu wuu shaqeeyaa iyadoo aan goobtan jirin.
about_tokens: Token-yadu waxay ku jiraan localStorage ee biraawsarkan waxaana loo diraa oo keliya forge-kooda. Kombuyuutar la wadaago, token-ka ka tag madhan ama ka saar markaad dhammayso.
about_share: Xiriiriyeyaasha wadaagga waxay ka kooban yihiin kaydka iyo jidka oo keliya, sidaas darteed kaydadka gaarka ah lama wadaagi karo.
about_template: Ku dar .hotdish/template.yml tafatir habaysan iyo tag-yo go'an ({link}).
about_rate_limit: Forge-yadu waxay xadaysaa dalabyada API saacaddiiba (GitHub: ku dhawaad 60 token la'aan, 5,000 token la). Ku dar token haddii aad aragto khaladaadka xadka.
token_guidance_github: Token gelitaan oo gaar ah, kaydkan oo keliya, Contents: akhris (qor si aad wax uga beddesho).
token_guidance_gitlab: Token mashruuc, read_repository (write_repository si aad wax uga beddesho).
token_guidance_gitea: Token leh akhrinta kaydka (qorista si aad wax uga beddesho).
token_placeholder_generic: Ikhtiyaari. Waxaa loo baahan yahay kaydadka gaarka ah iyo kaydinta isbeddellada
error_network_hosted: Lama gaari karo {host}. Hubi isku xirkaaga oo mar kale isku day.
error_network_self_hosted: Lama gaari karo {host}. Haddii ay tahay tusaale ku-ool-ku-hoste, API-gaadu laga yaabaa inuusan oggolayn dalabyada biraawsarka (CORS). Maamule {admin} ayaa awood u leh inuu furo — Gitea, deji ALLOW_DOMAIN qaybta [cors] ee app.ini.
error_auth_hint: Hubi in token-ka gelitaanku uu sax yahay oo uusan dhicin.
error_rate_limit_hint: Ku dar token gelitaan shakhsi ah kaydkan bogga hore si aad u kordhiso xadka, ama sug inta xadku dib u dejinayo.
error_denied_hint: Token-ku laga yaabaa inuusan fasax u lahayn kaydkan.
error_not_found_hint: Hubi kaydka, laantiisa, iyo jidka. Kaydadka gaarka ah waxay u baahan yihiin token.
error_conflict: Faylku wuu isbeddelay tan iyo markii la raray.
error_conflict_hint: Dib u rar cuntada si aad u hesho nooca ugu dambeeyay ka hor intaadan mar kale keydin.
error_move_conflict_hint: Dib u rar cuntada si aad u hesho nooca ugu dambeeyay ka hor intaadan guuriyin.
error_branch_changed: Laantii way isbeddeshay markii faylka la guurinayay.
error_branch_changed_hint: Dib u rar kaydka oo mar kale isku day.
error_move_failed_hint: Faylka waa laga saaray, ama server-ku wuu ka duwan yahay Gitea / Forgejo 1.20, oo loo baahan yahay guuritaanka faylasha.
error_token_required: Token gelitaan ayaa loo baahan yahay.
error_repo_input_short: Geli URL-ka kaydka oo dhan, ama milkiile/kayd.
error_url_invalid: Tani uma eka URL sax ah.
error_url_no_repo: URL-kaas ma laha milkiile iyo kayd.
error_link_incomplete: Xiriirkan waxaa ka maqan faahfaahinta kaydka.
template_error_mapping: Template-ku waa inuu noqdaa khariidad YAML ah.
template_error_empty: Template-ku ma qeexo goobo ama qaybo.
template_warn_field_no_key: Goob waxaa ka maqan "key" waana la dhaafay.
template_warn_field_type: Goobta "{key}" waxay leedahay nooc aan la aqoon "{type}"; waxaa loo qaatay qoraal.
template_warn_section_no_heading: Qayb waxaa ka maqan "heading" waana la dhaafay.
template_warn_section_type: Qaybta "{heading}" waxay leedahay nooc aan la aqoon "{type}"; waxaa loo qaatay qoraal.
frontmatter_error_pairs: Frontmatter waa inuu noqdaa urur lammaane furaha: qiimaha.
confirm_discard: Ma iska tuurtaa isbeddellada aan la keydin?
home_error_full_url: Geli URL-ka kaydka oo dhan si loo ogaado host-ka iyo forge-ka.
home_error_forge_unknown: Forge-kan si toos ah looma aqoonsan karo. Dooro nooca; API-yada ku-ool-ku-hostiga ayaa laga yaabaa inay xannibaan ogaanshaha biraawsarka.
home_reorder_hint: Jiid si aad u dib-u-habayso (ama isticmaal fallaaraha kor/hoos)
home_empty: Wali ma jiraan kayd la keydiyay. Isticmaal badhanka + si aad ugu darto.
repo_editor_timeout: Waqtigii ayaa dhammaaday markii tafatiraha la rarayay. Hubi console-ka biraawsarka.
repo_no_matches: Ma jirto cunto ku habboon shaandhooyinkan.
repo_truncated: Kaydkani aad buu u weyn yahay in dhammaantiis la qoro. Cuntooyin ayaa laga yaabaa inay maqan yihiin.
repo_template_error: Template-ka kaydka lama isticmaali karo ({error}). Tafatirku wuxuu ku laabanayaa markdown caadi ah.
commit_directly: Si toos ah ayuu ugu commit gareynayaa {branch}
editor_fix_frontmatter: Hagaaji frontmatter ka hor intaadan beddelin qaabka.
editor_fix_frontmatter_detail: Hagaaji frontmatter ka hor intaadan beddelin qaabka ({error}).
editor_raw_only: Frontmatter-ka faylkan lama kala falanqayn karo ({error}). Si aan loo lumin, waxaa la heli karaa oo keliya tafatirka markdown-ka asalka ah.
editor_using_template: Waxaa la isticmaalayaa template-ka {name} ee kaydkan.
editor_conflict: Faylku wuu isbeddelay kaydka tan iyo markii la raray. Dib u rar si aad u hesho nooca ugu dambeeyay — wax ka beddelkaaga halkan waa lumi doonaan, marka koobi ka samee wixii aad u baahan tahay.
rate_intro: {forge} ({host}) wuxuu diidayaa dalabyada sababtoo ah xadka API waa la dhaafay.
rate_wait: Sug daqiiqado ka hor intaadan mar kale isku dayin.
rate_token_hint: Ku darista token gelitaan shakhsi ah kaydkan ayaa kordhisa xadka.
share_private: Kaydkani waa gaar, sidaas darteed dadka aad xiriirkan la wadaagto waxay u baahan yihiin gelitaan u gaar ah si ay u furaan. Token-kaaga weligiis lagu darin xiriirka.
share_unknown: Lama xaqiijin karo in kaydkani yahay mid dadweyne. Haddii uu gaar yahay, dadka aad xiriirkan la wadaagto waxay u baahan yihiin gelitaan u gaar ah. Token-kaaga weligiis lagu darin xiriirka.
recipe_frontmatter_error: Frontmatter lama kala falanqayn karo ({error}). Waxaa loo muujiyay qayb ka mid ah jidhka waxaana loo ilaalin doonaa sida loo qoray.
delete_warning: Tani waxay ka saaraysaa {path} laanta. Weli waa lagu soo kaban karaa taariikhda commit-ka kaydka.
form_drag_hint: Jiid si aad u dib-u-habayso (ama isticmaal fallaaraha kor/hoos)
form_unmatched: Template-ku ma qeexin. Waxaa loo ilaalinayaa sida loo qoray.
